title: Remove the legacy synth path in infra/bin/chatticus.ts
description:
As a maintainer, I want the default 'legacy' three-environment synth path removed from infra/bin/chatticus.ts, so that there is one correct path now that no account deploys from it.

Feature: Single synth path
  Scenario: Synth without the legacy mode
    Given the legacy three-environment path is removed
    When infra synth and the infra tests run
    Then they pass and no stack depends on the legacy default
